'''Port Town District''' was an area located on the upper concourse of Cloud City.<ref name="TESB" /> The area was not to be confused with the notorious mid-level, [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]].

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Port Town District was established by the [[Special Edition Limited]] CCG as an area of Cloud city glimsed in the special edition re-release of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. As pictured, it differs greatly from the pre-established [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]] which is a mid-level industrial scale area.
